occupancy: strict histogram bins with >=1 observed cell; no hull interpolation or nearest-neighbor fill
PCA: exact original coordinate_dqn/coordinate_models.pt components and mean; no PCA fit
coordinate_validation: saved graph, exported DQN path, observed-expression encoder reproduction; live PCA if present
grid_query: bin-center PC -> z=PC@components+mean; higher PC scores zero; original DQN VAE and PCA
direction: normalize((encoder_mu(xKO)-encoder_mu(x)) @ PCA.components.T); zero vector stays zero
change_power: L2 of actual signed GRN target expression changes after zero-floor; source IKZF2 excluded
caveats: Expanded-VAE GRN powers transferred to original-VAE expression; only original-model targets are used. Treg-calibrated aggregate model-response GRN; source-amplitude scaling is assumed, not causal. Grid-center inverse PCA is a higher-PC-zero slice, not the actual latent of every cell in a bin. Arrows are a projected one-step perturbation response, not time velocity or guaranteed KO latent. Arrow lengths encode GRN expression response power, not PCA endpoint distance; no recursive propagation.
